description: NextClip helps you turn any YouTube video into short-form clips. Paste a link, choose your settings — clip length, aspect ratio, frame layout, and moment focus — and the AI finds the best moments and adds captions and hook text automatically. You get clips with title, description, and virality scores. You can export to MP4 and publish or schedule clips directly to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and Facebook from within the conversation.
